title: pleiospilos prismaticus
intro: Pleiospilos prismaticus, commonly known as the Prism Plant or Living Rock, is a succulent plant belonging to the family Aizoaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antibacterial agent.
